metadata.name: Cinder Foundry
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A steel-and-brick foundry over a lava floor. Catwalks cross the casting hall to two furnace islands (oil slickers), the centre line crumbles under you, trapdoors wait on the south runs, and a molten sluice splits the map. The crane gantry carries the rocket launcher over the hottest spot; the control room bridges the north wall above the sluice. Flamethrowers in the narrow duct behind the crucible houses, a slag yard to the north, a team base at each end.
